dialogues.speaker: Unfinished Supply Log
dialogues.text: "...The Treasure Hoarder Erge agreed to exchange food and other necessities for what's left of our money and military supplies..."

dialogues.speaker: Unfinished Supply Log
dialogues.text: "...Treasure Hoarders are in some trouble. It seems that they've lost their Weasel Thieves (?). Those who are still in The Chasm, please stay calm and wait."

dialogues.speaker: Unfinished Supply Log
dialogues.text: "...There has been an earthquake, which caused much panic among the Treasure Hoarders. They didn't deliver the food today..."

dialogues.speaker: Unfinished Supply Log
dialogues.text: "...Someone seems to have dispelled the Seven-Star Array. I need more information..."

dialogues.speaker: Unfinished Supply Log
dialogues.text: "...Clitopho, our contact from the Treasure Hoarders, went missing. As a result, our supplies are cut off for now..."
